camel_example: aliyun sls POST /source-models/query --region cn-hangzhou --header "Content-Type=application/json" --body '{"query":".umodel | where kind = '"'"'log_set'"'"' | limit 50"}'
description_en: Queries the content of a UModel by using SPL
description_zh: SPL 查询 UModel 内容
kebab_example: aliyun sls query-source-model --query '.umodel | where kind = '"'"'log_set'"'"' | limit 50' --region cn-hangzhou
name: QuerySourceModel

parameters.help_en: The name of the project. The model belongs to the project. One project corresponds to one model
parameters.help_zh: Project 名称。模型归属于该 Project，一个 Project 对应一个模型
parameters.name: project

parameters.help_en: The SPL query statement. This parameter cannot be empty. The data source is fixed to .umodel, which represents all elements in the model of the current project. Use the pipe operator (|) to perform filtering, projection, and limiting. Example: .umodel | where kind = 'log_set' | limit 50
parameters.help_zh: 一条 SPL 查询语句，不能为空。数据源固定为 .umodel，即本 Project 模型中的全部元素；用 | 接管道完成过滤、投影和限量，例如 .umodel | where kind = 'log_set' | limit 50
parameters.name: query

schema.description_en: The response body. Returns the column names and data rows matched by this query
schema.description_zh: 响应体。返回本次查询命中的列名与数据行

data.description_en: The data rows in the query result. If no data is matched, an empty array [] is returned
data.description_zh: 查询结果的数据行；无命中时为空数组 []

items.description_en: A single row of data. The order of the elements corresponds one-to-one with the header
items.description_zh: 单行数据，元素顺序与 header 一一对应

items.description_en: Cell values are always strings. The metadata, schema, and spec columns contain serialized JSON strings that require further parsing. Aggregate query results are also returned as strings
items.description_zh: 单元格取值，一律为字符串。metadata、schema、spec 列是序列化后的 JSON 字符串，需要再解析；聚合查询的结果同样以字符串返回

header.description_en: The column names matched by this query. The order corresponds one-to-one with the values in each data row. If no results are found, an empty array [] is returned
header.description_zh: 本次查询命中的列名，顺序与每行数据的取值一一对应；无结果时为空数组 []

items.description_en: A single column name. When you query model elements, the typical column names are kind, metadata, schema, and spec
items.description_zh: 单个列名。查询模型元素时通常为 kind、metadata、schema、spec

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body. Specifies the query statement for this execution
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 请求体。指定本次执行的查询语句
v1_body_parameters.name: body
